Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection checklist I1, which must be performed every four months as 
indicated by M4 in the title block
The technical specification of the 
CB max. rated voltage =145kv rated voltage is 132kv, rated current = 1250 A 
short-circuit current 31.5KA
The first draft is initiated and reviewed by eng. Soleiman 
Abd Elfattah Soleiman ,
accepted by eng. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad 
general director, and approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel; Head Sector 
of High Dam Hydraulic Power Station, Hyd.EPCo.
This document 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem MPIS Hyd.EPCo.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintanance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment, as Safety helmet and safety shoes
Switch off the CB and grounded its sides
Switch off DC supply control
Switch off the charging current (DC) motor wounding spring
Tools and Equipment
Portable air blower, metal brush
Set of common, Screwdrivers, cleaning material (rag, cloth), water pump, metal 
 wires

abnormal noise
Check the presence of

operation

drive rod (< 3mm)
Inspect the function of heaters
Record counter reading of operations counter

المواصفات الفنية للقاطع الكهربي: أقصى جهد مقنن = 145 ك.ف، والجهد المقنن 132 ك.ف، والتيار المقنن = 1250 أمبير، وتيار القصر 31.5 ك.أ

أُعدت المسودة الأولى وراجعها م. Soleiman Abd Elfattah Soleiman، وقبلها م. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad المدير العام، واعتمدها م. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel؛ رئيس قطاع محطة السد العالي للطاقة الكهرومائية، Hyd.EPCo.
صدّق على هذه الوثيقة م. Kamel Ragheb Hakem، MPIS Hyd.EPCo.

صدّق على هذه الوثيقة م. Kamel Ragheb Hakem، MPIS Hyd.EPCo.
